tasks.name: Web surface reconnaissance
tasks.instruction: Enumerate actuator/common endpoints on target URL and record reachable paths and response signatures.

tasks.name: Detect SSRF/proxy entry points
tasks.instruction: Identify proxy-like endpoints and test controlled internal URL fetch behavior in authorized scope.

output.reasoning: No endpoints discovered yet; prioritize web recon and actuator enumeration before exploit attempts.

tasks.name: Standard HTTP/HTTPS enumeration
tasks.instruction: Perform comprehensive path enumeration using common dictionaries and collect status codes, headers, and response sizes.

tasks.name: Identify security misconfigurations
tasks.instruction: Check for exposed configs, backup files, debug endpoints, and other common web misconfigurations.

output.reasoning: Initial surface recon required; establish baseline of reachable endpoints before vulnerability analysis.

tasks.name: Validate SSRF path to metadata
tasks.instruction: Validate IMDSv2 flow via proxy endpoint (token request then metadata calls) and capture evidence.

tasks.name: Extract temporary cloud credentials
tasks.instruction: If metadata access is confirmed, enumerate role name and retrieve temporary credentials in-scope.

output.reasoning: Proxy surface detected; chain SSRF->metadata->credential extraction to elevate access.

tasks.name: Analyze authentication mechanism
tasks.instruction: Reverse-engineer login flow, identify auth tokens, check for default credentials, and look for auth bypass techniques.

tasks.name: Attempt auth bypass or session acquisition
tasks.instruction: Try common auth bypass patterns (SQL injection, JWT manipulation, default creds) or acquire valid session through authorized testing.

output.reasoning: Authentication workflow confirmed; prioritize obtaining valid session/credentials for deeper access.

tasks.name: Enumerate identity and permissions
tasks.instruction: Use extracted credentials to identify principal and enumerate effective IAM permissions via sts:GetCallerIdentity and iam:GetUser.

tasks.name: Enumerate sensitive storage/resources
tasks.instruction: Enumerate accessible S3 buckets, Secrets Manager entries, RDS instances, and record high-risk exposures.

output.reasoning: AWS credentials acquired; pivot to cloud enumeration for privilege escalation and lateral movement.

tasks.name: Enumerate Azure role assignments
tasks.instruction: Use credentials to enumerate role assignments and RBAC permissions across subscription and resource groups.

tasks.name: Extract secrets from Key Vault
tasks.instruction: Attempt to enumerate and extract secrets from accessible Azure Key Vault instances.

output.reasoning: Azure service credentials acquired; enumerate RBAC and Key Vault for secrets and privilege escalation.

tasks.name: Validate GitLab version and preconditions
tasks.instruction: Confirm GitLab version via /api/v4/version endpoint and verify affected version range for CVE-2021-22205.

tasks.name: Check exploit preconditions
tasks.instruction: Verify that file upload functionality is reachable and avatar processing is enabled (required for this CVE).

output.reasoning: CVE candidate identified; validate version certainty and preconditions before attempting exploit.

tasks.name: Run safe PoC validator for CVE-2021-22205
tasks.instruction: Execute authorized non-destructive PoC that validates command execution capability without causing damage (e.g., sleep command with time measurement).

tasks.name: Capture proof-of-effect evidence
tasks.instruction: Document successful command execution with timestamps and output, establishing definitive proof of vulnerability.

output.reasoning: All preconditions validated; proceed with authorized PoC to establish proof-of-concept.

tasks.name: Enumerate internal network and services
tasks.instruction: From compromised host, scan internal network ranges (RFC 1918) to identify additional services, databases, and cloud metadata endpoints.

tasks.name: Attempt lateral movement and privilege escalation
tasks.instruction: Use extracted credentials to pivot to accessible internal services (databases, cloud APIs, internal web apps) and escalate privileges where possible.

output.reasoning: Exploit successful; pivot to internal reconnaissance and lateral movement for deeper access.

failure_history.reason: Target version is 13.11, not in affected range
Proxy endpoint requires authentication which was not acquired

tasks.name: Diagnose exploit failure preconditions
tasks.instruction: Analyze failed attempts and identify root causes: wrong version range, missing auth, unreachable path, or unmet technical preconditions.

tasks.name: Collect missing evidence before retry
tasks.instruction: Run low-cost validators to confirm missing preconditions (correct version, required auth, reachable service). Only retry after evidence confirms applicability.

output.reasoning: Multiple exploits failed due to unmet preconditions; diagnose root causes and gather missing evidence before retry attempts.

tasks.name: Re-enumerate service account RBAC
tasks.instruction: Query actual RBAC permissions granted to current service account via auth/can-i and identify exploitable paths within granted permissions.

tasks.name: Pivot via permitted resources
tasks.instruction: Focus enumeration on resources where RBAC permits access (e.g., secrets, configmaps, pods in specific namespaces).

output.reasoning: Initial approach failed due to insufficient RBAC; replan to exploit permitted resources instead.

tasks.name: Baseline service discovery
tasks.instruction: Perform lightweight in-scope service discovery and identify externally reachable assets, open ports, and running services.

tasks.name: Collect stack fingerprints
tasks.instruction: Collect app/cloud stack fingerprints from headers, response content, and error messages; map initial attack surface.

output.reasoning: No strong prior signal; establish baseline attack surface and technology fingerprints first.

tasks.name: Cloud service discovery
tasks.instruction: Identify exposed AWS services (S3, ECR, Cognito, Lambda, API Gateway) via DNS, HTTP headers, and well-known endpoints.

tasks.name: Probe IMDS and metadata exposure
tasks.instruction: Test for indirect access to AWS instance metadata via SSRF, proxy endpoints, or server-side fetch features.

output.reasoning: Initial reconnaissance with no prior information; start with broad cloud service discovery before targeting specific vulnerabilities.

tasks.name: Azure service enumeration
tasks.instruction: Identify Azure-hosted services from URL patterns (azurewebsites, blob.core.windows.net, vault.azure.net) and certificate metadata.

tasks.name: Probe Azure IMDS surfaces
tasks.instruction: Look for SSRF surfaces that allow reaching 169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token for managed identity tokens.

output.reasoning: Azure target detected; prioritize Azure-specific recon patterns and managed identity discovery.

tasks.name: GCP service enumeration
tasks.instruction: Detect GCP services from URL patterns (appspot, run.app, storage.googleapis.com, cloudfunctions.net) and HTTP headers.

tasks.name: Probe GCP metadata server
tasks.instruction: Test SSRF surfaces for access to metadata.google.internal with Metadata-Flavor: Google header to retrieve service account tokens.

output.reasoning: GCP target detected; enumerate GCP-native services and probe for metadata server access.

tasks.name: Azure resource enumeration
tasks.instruction: Login via az ad sp credentials and enumerate accessible subscriptions, resource groups, storage accounts, and key vaults.

tasks.name: Storage account access
tasks.instruction: List blob containers in discovered storage accounts and check public access settings.

output.reasoning: Azure SP credentials extracted; pivot to ARM enumeration and storage access.

tasks.name: Validate Azure Functions CVE
tasks.instruction: Verify the target's Azure Functions runtime version and confirm vulnerability match for CVE-2025-30387 before exploit attempt.

output.reasoning: CVE candidate identified for Azure Functions; validate version match before exploitation.

tasks.name: GCP project enumeration
tasks.instruction: Activate service account and run gcloud projects list, gcloud iam service-accounts list, gcloud storage buckets list.

tasks.name: GCS bucket enumeration
tasks.instruction: List objects in accessible buckets and check IAM policy for public/world-readable bindings.

output.reasoning: GCP service account key extracted; enumerate IAM, projects, and GCS buckets.
